requirements.title: Entrar y salir
requirements.statement: WHEN a user submits a registered email and its password THE system SHALL open a session and show the home of their role

requirements.title: Inventario
requirements.statement: WHEN the encargado adds units of an item type THE system SHALL increase its stock, and WHEN he withdraws broken units that no loan or reservation needs THE system SHALL reduce it

criteria.text: GIVEN "Cuerda" has 4 units WHEN the encargado adds 2 units THEN the user sees "Cuerda: 6 unidades" in "Material"
